mapper.select: SELECT GRP_CD , GRP_CD_LVL , GRP_CD_ORD , USE_YN , GRP_CD_NM , GRP_CD_TREE_NM , VRNT1 , VRNT2 , VRNT3 , VRNT4 , VRNT5 , PRNT_GRP_CD , GRP_CD_SORT_PATH FROM CMN_GRP_CD_TREE_VIEW ORDER BY GRP_CD_SORT_PATH;

SELECT CMN_GRP_CD.GRP_CD , CMN_GRP_CD.GRP_CD_LVL , CMN_GRP_CD.GRP_CD_ORD , CMN_GRP_CD.USE_YN , CMN_GRP_CD.GRP_CD_NM , CMN_GRP_CD.PRNT_GRP_CD , ( SELECT GRP_CD_NM FROM CMN_GRP_CD_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND GRP_CD = CMN_GRP_CD.PRNT_GRP_CD ) AS PRNT_GRP_CD_NM , CMN_GRP_CD.VRNT1 , CMN_GRP_CD.VRNT2 , CMN_GRP_CD.VRNT3 , CMN_GRP_CD.VRNT4 , CMN_GRP_CD.VRNT5 , CMN_GRP_CD.GRP_CD_DESC , TO_CHAR(CMN_GRP_CD.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , CMN_GRP_CD.RGST_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = CMN_GRP_CD.RGST_SEQ ) AS RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(CMN_GRP_CD.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , CMN_GRP_CD.UPDT_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = CMN_GRP_CD.UPDT_SEQ ) AS UPDT_NM FROM CMN_GRP_CD_INFO_TBL CMN_GRP_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND (((#{grpCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{grpCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (CMN_GRP_CD.GRP_CD = #{grpCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{prntGrpCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{prntGrpCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (CMN_GRP_CD.PRNT_GRP_CD = #{prntGrpCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}))

SELECT CMN_CD.GRP_CD , CMN_CD.CD , CMN_CD.CD_ORD , CMN_CD.USE_YN , CMN_CD.CD_NM , CMN_CD.VRNT1 , CMN_CD.VRNT2 , CMN_CD.VRNT3 , CMN_CD.VRNT4 , CMN_CD.VRNT5 , CMN_CD.CD_DESC , TO_CHAR(CMN_CD.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , CMN_CD.RGST_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = CMN_CD.RGST_SEQ ) AS RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(CMN_CD.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , CMN_CD.UPDT_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = CMN_CD.UPDT_SEQ ) AS UPDT_NM FROM CMN_CD_INFO_TBL CMN_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND CMN_CD.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (((#{grpCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{grpCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (CMN_CD.GRP_CD = #{grpCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{cd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{cd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (CMN_CD.CD = #{cd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}))

SELECT CMN_CD.GRP_CD , CMN_CD.CD , CMN_CD.CD_ORD , CMN_CD.USE_YN , CMN_CD.CD_NM , CMN_CD.VRNT1 , CMN_CD.VRNT2 , CMN_CD.VRNT3 , CMN_CD.VRNT4 , CMN_CD.VRNT5 , CMN_CD.CD_DESC , TO_CHAR(CMN_CD.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , CMN_CD.RGST_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = CMN_CD.RGST_SEQ ) AS RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(CMN_CD.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , CMN_CD.UPDT_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = CMN_CD.UPDT_SEQ ) AS UPDT_NM FROM CMN_CD_INFO_TBL CMN_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND CMN_CD.GRP_CD = #{grpCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CMN_CD.CD = #{cd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
